cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketeer position at Unilin. With a passion for creating content that drives visibility and engagement, and a strong foundation in SEO and GEO, I am eager to contribute to the growth of your premium flooring brands.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in on-page SEO, keyword research, and content writing. I have successfully managed WordPress sites, ensuring they are optimized for search engines and user experience. My work involves tracking performance using tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Analytics, and using data to continuously improve content strategies.

My personal project, mirook.com, has been a playground for experimenting with advanced SEO and GEO techniques. I implemented structured data (JSON-LD), entity optimization, and an llms.txt file to enhance visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on experience has given me a deep understanding of how to make content discoverable in the evolving digital landscape.

I am a strong copywriter with a natural feel for tone of voice and storytelling. I am digitally savvy, comfortable with CMS and content management tools, and data-driven yet creative. I am fluent in English and able to create engaging content for an international audience.

Unilin's commitment to sustainability and innovation resonates with me, and I am excited about the opportunity to work with a team that values lifelong learning and development. I am confident that my skills and enthusiasm make me a great fit for this role.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Unilin's digital marketing success.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
